# Lucid Community

> A vibrant community hub for Lucidchart, Lucidspark, and Lucidscale users to collaborate, share ideas, get peer support, and stay updated on product releases.

The Lucid Community serves as the central gathering place for users of Lucid Software Inc.'s visual collaboration suite. Members can access peer support, discover best practices, participate in exclusive programs like Lucid Legends, and engage with developers through dedicated forums and groups.

## Key Topics

- Lucidchart
- Lucidspark
- Lucidscale
- Lucid Suite
- Lucid Legends
- Peer Support
- Product Updates
- Developer Community
- Community Forum
- Collaboration
- User Engagement
- Best Practices
- Process Agent
- Object Assets

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to the Lucid Community](https://community.lucid.co/welcome-to-the-lucid-community-15/welcome-to-the-lucid-community-5437): Welcome guide and onboarding for new Lucid community members
- [Join the Conversation](https://community.lucid.co/topic/new): Forum page for creating new discussion topics and questions
- [Community Groups](https://community.lucid.co/groups): Community groups organized by role, industry, and product interest

## Support & Help

- [Peer Support](https://community.lucid.co/support-1): Peer support forum for Lucidchart, Lucidspark, and Lucidscale help
- [Unanswered Questions](https://community.lucid.co/activity/unanswered): View unanswered questions needing community support and assistance
- [Recently Active Topics](https://community.lucid.co/activity/recent): Browse recently active community forum topics and discussions

## Product Updates & News

- [Release Notes](https://community.lucid.co/product-updates): Release notes and product updates for Lucid Suite and tools
- [Community News and Announcements](https://community.lucid.co/community-news-and-announcements-9): Monthly news and announcements for Lucid community members
- [AI Update - Process Agent](https://community.lucid.co/ideas/ai-update-process-agent-12853): Product update announcement for new Process Agent AI feature
- [Object Assets: Build Faster with Standardized Shapes](https://community.lucid.co/inspiration-5/object-assets-build-faster-with-standardized-shapes-12859): Announcement of Object assets feature for Process Accelerator

## Learning & Inspiration

- [Inspiration & Use Cases](https://community.lucid.co/inspiration-5): Templates, use cases, and collaboration ideas for Lucid products
- [Lucid Power User Kit](https://community.lucid.co/community-news-and-announcements-9/lucid-power-user-kit-help-your-team-get-more-out-of-lucid-12791): Power User Kit announcement with training resources and best practices

## Community Programs & Recognition

- [Lucid Legends](https://community.lucid.co/p/lucid-legends): Lucid Legends community program for expert members and rewards

## Developer Resources

- [Developer Community](https://community.lucid.co/lucid-for-developers-6): Developer community for API support and technical collaboration
